title: Marketsquare
tagline: peer-to-peer decentralized marketplace where you can buy and sell items
description:
This project is a marketplace application built on top of Base. It offers users a secure platform to buy and sell items with cryptocurrencies.

The application includes following features:
- chat, buyer and seller can chat with one another
- location based listings, seller can specify location of their item and buyer can filter by location
- feedback, user feedback is minted as nft on chain
how_its_made:
below is overview of the technologies the project leverages

frontend
- nextjs as main framework
- react as main ui
- css for styling

backend
- rainbowkit for wallet integration
- trpc for typesafe
- psql for database
- hardhat for smart contract testing
